title: 'I almost fell asleep' - drivers react to dull Madring F1 debut
paragraphs: The 2026 Spanish Grand Prix was a procession - but what do Formula 1 drivers think is the main problem with the Madring, and what are their proposed solutions? The Madring is part new, permanent circuit, and part existing roads that flow in and out of the IFEMA conference centre in the north-east of Madrid. It therefore benefitted from a partial blank slate.

title: What the teams said – Race day at the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix
paragraphs: Kimi Antonelli got a great start from P2, but when challenging for the lead cut the apex of the corner and was forced to cede position. His attempts to do so were messy and he briefly fell behind Verstappen until the Dutchman had to do the same thing. That left Antonelli second, a few seconds behind race leader Norris.
